Name: Louvier Fromagerie (GMM)
Author: Elaho
Description:
[size=5][b]Welcome to Louvier Fromagerie![/b][/size]
 
[quote]﻿﻿[size=4]**AUG 31, 2024:

THIS MOD IS CURRENTLY BROKEN IN STARDEW 1.6!! Louvier Fromagerie is NOT compatible with the latest 1.6 update.
[/size]
But!! The latest version is expected to be launched in Winter 2024. I'll be updating pages on this mod, including the Changelogs and Description  [Warning: Spoilers!] as the transition takes place. In the meantime, follow my [url=http://elaho.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url]﻿ for more details and sneak peeks for what's to come. 

Thank you all for your patience and continued support  :)

-Elaho[/quote]
This mod is a part of a larger mod-in-progress called “TheGrampleton Maker’s Market” and features a bi-monthly temporary cheese shop (“fromagerie”)
where players can purchase a variety of traditional French and Western European cheeses, producers, and recipes.
 
-- Please note that this version of Louvier Fromagerie is a demo/beta test version of the upcoming GMM mod expansion and only features a
portion of what will be included in the main mod. --

[b][size=3]How to Make the Fromagerie Appear: (Light Spoilers)[/size][/b]

To have Louvier Fromagerie appear in the Town Square, players must have upgraded their farmhouse to include a kitchen. After Robin has upgraded your house, you will receive a letter in the mail from Lewis explaining the Maker’s Market. You MUST have read this letter for the shop to appear.
After the letter has been read, the Fromagerie will set up shop every 6th, 7th, 20th, and 21st of each month (except winter) in the Town
Square. The shop will be open from 9 AM to 6 PM regardless of the weather.
 
[size=3][b]PLEASE NOTE: [/b][/size]This Mod Package Requires the [u][MFM] The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter [beta][/u] which must be downloaded from the official [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13421]Grampleton Maker’s Market Letter[/url] (beta) page.
 
Louvier Fromagerie features some base dairy products and recipes that are always available for purchase, as well as unique cheeses, and recipes that become available as players advance their farming, fishing, mining, combat, and foraging skills. 


[size=3][b]Louvier Fromagerie Special Features:[/b][/size]

[u][b]New Vendors:[/b][/u]
Louvier Fromagerie also includes two unique shop vendors: Amelie and Patrice, who will appear on specific days and times during the Maker’s Market.

Amelie is the primary vendor for the Fromagerie. She manages the “front of house” with her father Augustin, who appears standing next to her in the shop. All unlocked cheeses can be purchased from Amelie, but she will uniquely sell producer crafting recipes as the player advances their skills. Amelie runs the Fromagerie on Saturdays from 9am-6pm, and Sundays from 9am-11am and 3pm-6pm

Patrice is a part-time employee of the Fromagerie, coming to Pelican Town on Sundays to manage the shop while the Louvier family is away. All unlocked cheeses can be purchased from Patrice, but she will uniquely sell cooking recipes as the player advances their skills. Patrice runs the Fromagerie on Sundays from 11:30am-3pm.
[u]
[b]New Producers:[/b][/u]
Louvier Fromagerie introduces 7 new crafting recipes for traditional cheese presses and butter churns. Each producer can produce two types of cheese or butter: cow’s milk and goat’s milk.

-- Butter churns require either 2 small milks or 1 large milk to produce 1 stick of butter.

-- Cheese presses require either 4 small milks or 2 large milks to produce 2 of the same cheese product. Processing times will vary depending on the type of cheese (1-3 weeks).


[b][size=3]Louvier Fromagerie 1.2.0 includes (but is not limited to):
[/size][/b]
- 2 new artisanal butters
- 11 new artisanal cow cheeses
- 11 new artisanal goat cheeses
- 12 new producer crafting recipes (unlockable)
- Iridium quality artisanal cheeses and butters for sale (seasonal) (unlockable)
- *40 new recipes (unlockable) (seasonal)
- 2 new recipes that unlock in Joseph’s Seed Shop (mod compatible)– must have Joseph’s Seed Shop installed.
   And more!

(*Please note that some recipes will only appear when Animal Husbandry is installed. Please see Mod Requirements for more details)

[size=3][b]Mod Requirements and Compatibility:[/b][/size]
The following mods must be installed for Louvier Fromagerieto to work properly:
-- Content Patcher
-- SMAPI
-- Mail Framework Mod
-- JSON assets
-- Shop Tile Framework
-- Expanded Preconditions Utility
-- Producer Framework Mod
-- **[MFM] The Grampleton Maker's Market Letter** (Please see note above, this mod is REQUIRED)
 
Optional, but highly recommended mods:
- Joseph’s Seed Shop (GMM)
- Animal Husbandry*
([b]*Please note: [/b]The recipes "Croque Madame", "Eggs Arsene", "Surprise Bread", "Leek Vol au Vents", "Solomillio al Cabrales", and "Picodon Roti au Lard" will ONLY appear when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] is installed)
 
This mod is compatible with both Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded maps but hasn’t been playtested with any other map-editing mods.


[size=3][b]How to Install:
[/b][/size]
'Louvier Fromagerie' is a mod bundle of 6 different mods:
 
[CP] Louvier Fromagerie Shop Storefront,
[JA] Louvier Fromagerie Cheese Recipes,
[JA] Louvier Fromagerie Producers,
[PFM] Louvier Fromagerie Producers,
[STF] Louvier Fromagerie Amelie,
[STF] Louvier Fromagerie Patrice,
 
All 6 must be installed for the mod to work properly.
To install, please download the bundle and open the file. Inside you should find the six different mod folders. Drag and drop each separate folder into the 'Mods" folder.
 
*Please note that all future updates to this mod bundle require deleting all 6 mods separately and reinstalling them. 


[size=3][b]Known Bugs/Glitches: (As of 1.2.0)
[/b][/size]
1.  Both the Cheddar Cheese Press and Camembert Cheese Press sprites glitch when appearing on the Town map. This includes the actual press in the player’s inventory, in the crafting menu, and in the shop menu. This glitch is aesthetic only and does not affect game performance (i.e., the cheese press will still produce cheese), and is likely to be patched out in the upcoming 1.6 version of Stardew Valley. The glitched sprite goes back to normal when the player is present on any other map besides the Town.

2.     The names of items in both the cooking and crafting menus will include an “LF” suffix. This is necessary to add compatibility with other mods and is a known bug; however, this is temporary and will be fixed in the upcoming 1.6 version of Stardew Valley. 


[b][size=3]The Future of this Mod (and The Grampleton Maker’s Market):[/size][/b]
 
[u]Q: Will shop owners become NPC's?
[/u]
﻿Plans are being made to add more artisans to the GrampletonMaker’s Market, as well as turn the shop owners into interactable NPC’s with their own backstories and heart events. Plans are also in the works to include some future items in CC bundles for players who want a more challenging
playthrough.
 
[u]﻿Q: Will more items be added to this mod?
[/u]
As of right now, no new items will be added to the shop. However, plans are being made to add more cheeses, recipes, and items for sale
in the future.
 
[u]﻿Q: Is this mod available in other languages?
[/u]
This mod is currently only available in English, but translations are welcome and will be implemented in future updates.
 
[u]﻿Q: What Nations are Amelie and Patrice from?[/u]

Amelie is French-Acadian, her father Augustin being French(from France) and her mother being Acadian. (The Acadian people are of mixed French and Indigenous ancestry; their homeland, also known as “Acadia” or “L’Acadie”, stretches across the Canadian Province of New Brunswick, as well as some parts of Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, and Quebec; as well as the northeastern state of Maine and some regions of Louisiana [“Cajun”] in the USA.) An official fictional nation for Amelie has not yet been decided.

Patrice is Afro-Caribbean from the nation of Haiti, a small island nation in the Caribbean Sea. In Stardew Valley, Patrice will be from a tropical island nation in the Gem Sea. An official fictional nation for Patrice has not yet been decided.
